name: lintel
title: Lintel
description: A structural engineer's theme drawn as a calculation sheet on shuttered concrete: every service is a loaded beam in red-oxide primer on a pin and a roller, its title over the load arrows and its fee written into the dimension line beneath.

tokens.--font-display: condensed capitals: site title, menu, titles, headings, labels
tokens.--font-text: running text, notes under each service, roles and biographies
tokens.--font-mono: figures: fees, beam references, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, dates, credentials, code
tokens.--text-small: small print: beam references, dates, the firm name on a sheet, the footer
tokens.--color-bg: the shuttered concrete, the page background
tokens.--color-text: black ink: all text, load arrows, dimension and witness lines, the hatched ground, heavy rules, the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: beam references, labels, the firm name on a sheet, dates, the page counter, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: red-oxide primer: beam, pin and roller, the line under links, the current menu item, the arrows beside what a job covers
tokens.--color-panel: white sheets: the services list, the large beam of a service page, the first-meeting box, tables, code, the pad behind the focus ring
tokens.--color-line: thin rules on sheets: between services and news items, beside the reference and note columns, table and hours rows
tokens.--color-grid: the faint squares of the calculation paper
tokens.--color-joint: shutter-panel joints on the concrete and the rim of each dimple
tokens.--color-dimple: the hollow of each tie-bolt dimple
tokens.--side-col: width of the column of titles beside the sheet on a wide screen
tokens.--ref-col: width of the reference column (B1, B2 …) on a wide sheet
tokens.--grid-cell: size of one square of the calculation paper
tokens.--shutter-width: width of one shutter panel, joint to joint
tokens.--shutter-height: height of one shutter panel, joint to joint
tokens.--load-height: height of the load arrows over each beam
tokens.--support: size of the pin and the roller
tokens.--rule-heavy: weight of heavy rules: masthead, sheet and block heads, menu marker
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of sheets, tables and covers
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page on a phone
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a title and its beam
tokens.--space-3: padding inside a sheet, gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: beside the side column and below the page
